d: A humanoid fish species with shimmering aquamarine scales and a long, powerful tapered tail in a deep teal shade. The head features a pair of long, flowing fins resembling hair in a bright turquoise hue and large, expressive golden-yellow eyes. The upper body is slender with three slender fingers on each hand, wearing an ornate gold and sea-foam green seashell bodice. BODY COLOR: aquamarine
